summary: Iteration 7 testing — admin dashboard (4 new tabs) + cart gift_note + AI session_id + showcase tagging + forum @mentions + magic-link auth regression. Backend pytest: 20/21 PASS (1 real bug: AI session context not retained). Frontend Playwright: admin dashboard renders, all 4 new tabs (Analytics/Listings/Users/Reviews) load with admin JWT injected, Analytics shows GMV $567 + community/showcase/forum counts, Reviews tab create+delete works end-to-end, Listings PATCH (featured toggle) verified via API. Cart gift-note textarea is present and accepts input but DOES NOT persist on page reload — explicit user requirement violated. CheckoutSuccess gating logic (paid && !cm_buyer_jwt) is correctly implemented in JSX (verified by code inspection — data-testid='success-create-account-btn' guarded by `canCreateAccount`). Showcase auto-link tagging works (POST /community/showcase persists product_slug + maker_slug, ShowcaseCard renders <Link to=/shop/{slug}> + <Link to=/makers/{slug}>). Forum @mentions: backend stores body verbatim with '@username' — rendering/highlighting on frontend not deeply verified but data-testid wiring is in place.

critical.issue: Conversation context is NOT retained across requests despite session_id being echoed back. /app/backend/routers/ai.py creates a fresh LlmChat instance per request and does not replay prior turns from db.ai_chats. Repro: turn 1 'my favorite color is fuchsia' → turn 2 'what color did I just tell you?' (same session_id) → reply: 'You haven't told me a color yet — this is the start of our conversation.' Frontend localStorage session_id persistence works fine; the bug is server-side.

ui_bugs.issue: Gift-note textarea state is plain useState("") — does NOT persist across page reload. Explicit requirement was 'persists across page reload (localStorage)'. Repro: /cart → fill cart-gift-note → reload → field is empty. Recommended fix: useState(() => localStorage.getItem('cm_gift_note') || '') + useEffect to write on change, and clear on successful checkout (alongside cart.clear()).

action_items: BACKEND FIX (/app/backend/routers/ai.py): replay db.ai_chats turns into LlmChat before send_message, OR pass message history via UserMessage list. Currently each /ai/chat call constructs a fresh LlmChat and sends only the current user message, so prior context is lost despite session_id continuity. The frontend already correctly passes session_id round-trip.

FRONTEND FIX (/app/frontend/src/pages/CartPage.jsx): persist giftNote to localStorage. Init: useState(() => localStorage.getItem('cm_gift_note') || ''). Add useEffect on giftNote → setItem. Clear in checkout() success path (or on /checkout/success once paid). Required by problem statement.
Carry-forward (iter5): stale-closure in CommunityPage.jsx ChatTab onWsMessage — unread/mention counter misses on previously-active channel after switch. Not retested this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx — `tab` initial state is 'applications' but TABS list starts with 'analytics' on the request. Cosmetic only. The Analytics tab is fully wired and testid='analytics-tab' renders correctly when clicked.

AI ChatRequest doesn't include conversation_history or load it from db.ai_chats. The session_id is functionally a transcript-key only, not a memory key. emergentintegrations LlmChat does not auto-load history from session_id alone — history must be replayed each call.
CartPage gift-note: useState only, no localStorage. Even though `email` field also doesn't persist (that's acceptable — receipt-only), gift-note was an explicit persistence requirement.
Admin /admin/community-users response correctly excludes _id. Listing/PATCH product also clean.
Cross-role rejection works: maker JWT → /admin/me → 403, buyer JWT → /maker/me → 403, buyer JWT → /admin/analytics → 403. Verified.
Forum endpoints are POST /community/forum and POST /community/forum/{tid}/reply (singular). README/main-agent expectations of /threads + /replies are wrong — use the actual paths.

rca of the issue: AI memory bug: /app/backend/routers/ai.py line 86-93 — `LlmChat(api_key=..., session_id=session_id, system_message=...).with_model(...).send_message(UserMessage(text=req.message))` — fresh instance per request, only the current message is sent. emergentintegrations LlmChat treats session_id as a transcript identifier; conversation history is NOT auto-fetched from any backing store. Fix: load `prior = await db.ai_chats.find({'session_id': session_id}).sort('created_at',1).to_list(40)`, then for each turn call chat.send_message(UserMessage(text=t['user'])) and chat.add_assistant_message(t['assistant']) (or whatever emergentintegrations exposes), THEN send the new message. Alternatively, build a single UserMessage that includes the transcript as preamble. Cart gift-note bug: trivial — just wrap useState init with localStorage read and add a useEffect setItem.
